title: Application login timeout
description: Users cannot log in because authentication requests time out
symptoms: Login timeout slow authentication session failure
resolution: Restart authentication service and verify identity provider connectivity

title: Single sign-on failure
description: Employees receive SSO authentication errors when accessing internal applications
symptoms: SSO login failure invalid authentication token
resolution: Refresh identity provider metadata and validate SSO configuration

title: Database connection pool exhausted
description: Application cannot connect to database because all connections are occupied
symptoms: Database connection timeout pool exhausted too many connections
resolution: Identify long running queries and increase connection pool capacity where appropriate

title: Slow application response
description: Users experience slow page loading and delayed application responses
symptoms: Slow application high response time latency
resolution: Analyze application performance logs and optimize resource intensive queries

title: VPN connection failure
description: Remote employees cannot establish secure VPN connections
symptoms: VPN connection failure remote access tunnel unavailable
resolution: Verify VPN gateway status and validate user network configuration

title: DNS resolution failure
description: Internal services cannot be reached because hostnames fail to resolve
symptoms: DNS lookup failure hostname resolution network issue
resolution: Check DNS server availability and correct affected DNS records

title: Server disk space exhausted
description: Application services fail because the server disk is full
symptoms: Disk full storage capacity exhausted write failure
resolution: Clean approved temporary files archive old logs and expand storage if required

title: Email delivery queue delayed
description: Outgoing emails remain queued and are not delivered on time
symptoms: Email queue backlog delayed delivery mail server
resolution: Inspect mail server logs and restart the affected mail transport service if safe

title: API rate limit exceeded
description: API requests are rejected after exceeding configured request limits
symptoms: HTTP 429 too many requests API rate limit
resolution: Review API usage patterns and implement retry with exponential backoff

title: Expired TLS certificate
description: Users receive browser security warnings when accessing an internal service
symptoms: TLS SSL certificate expired HTTPS certificate warning
resolution: Renew the TLS certificate and verify the complete certificate chain

title: Shared folder permission denied
description: Employees cannot access a shared folder due to permission errors
symptoms: Shared folder access denied permission error
resolution: Review access control lists and restore approved user or group permissions

title: Deployment configuration failure
description: Application deployment fails because required environment variables are missing
resolution: Validate deployment configuration and restore required environment variables
